title: Windows fixes
summary: Git commands no longer open a console window on Windows, and the app shows its icon there.

improvements.title: Mugetsu icon on Windows
improvements.body: The app, its taskbar entry and the installer now show the Mugetsu icon.

fixes.title: No more console windows on Windows
fixes.body: Every git, gh or glab command used to flash a terminal window; they now run hidden.
